result.summary: Expands BIP30 functional test coverage in feature_block.py to test duplicate non-coinbase transactions. It verifies that re-including a duplicate regular transaction is rejected with bad-txns-BIP30 while its outputs remain unspent, and accepted once they are spent. Subsequent block tests in the suite are adjusted to build upon the new chain tip.
result.problem: BIP30 validation ensures transactions cannot overwrite unspent outputs, applying to all transactions in a block. Existing test coverage only exercised duplicate coinbase transactions, leaving duplicate non-coinbase validation untested.
evidence: The PR description links to mutant 4389 (mutanthub.space/mutants/4389), demonstrating that a mutation in src/validation.cpp restricting BIP30 checks strictly to block.vtx[0] survived the test suite.
result.card: Expands BIP30 functional testing in feature_block.py to cover duplicate non-coinbase transactions. Previously, test coverage only exercised duplicate coinbases, leaving consensus enforcement against duplicate regular transactions untested. The author demonstrates that this test kills a consensus-validation mutant that restricted BIP30 checks exclusively to coinbases.

risk.why: A flaw in this change would only result in functional test failures or false passes in CI.
